scope: Latest-candidate documentation and metadata audit only;candidate performance not independently reproduced.

LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M.selection: Smaller chat model with browser demo,custom LFM license;Hebrew absent from9 declared languages. Not assumed incapable,but no evidence justifies preferring it for first Hebrew conversation pilot.

foolish-bandit/cadence-0.8b-browser.selection: Author explicitly says typed decision model,not chat generation;custom loader. Not a replacement for conversational LLM.

Wissotsky/TamiLM-Hebrew-Nano.selection: Hebrew RWKVv6 base model,512 training context,custom runtime andAGPL3;older release,no verified ready browser dialogue path.

RoeiG/Laya-Hebrew-V2.1.selection: New Hebrew/English decision model,not generation;CC-BY-NC-SA4.0 noncommercial. Author benchmarks not replicated;not browser-qualified.

yoavipo/nativ-he-decision.selection: New Hebrew decision model,CC-BY4commercial-use attribution license. Could be studied as a decision component,not a full chat model. Author benchmarks not replicated;not browser-qualified.

sources.finding: Current foundation-model Prompt API documentation excludes Chrome Android/iOS;not a broad mobile-browser solution.
Developer reports actual Qwen3.5-0.8B WebGPU demo,not Hebrew recipe quality.
Domain-specific model compilation/LoRA merge example for browser deployment,not Hebrew performance evidence.

bounded_search_conclusion: No clearly superior ready-to-use sub1B Hebrew conversational browser model established in the searched primary sources. Decision-only models are a different capability,not equivalent chat replacements.
